description: Pro only: create one short link for a mobile app. iPhones and iPads that open it go to the app's App Store page, Android devices to its Google Play page, and any other device (such as a desktop) sees a Gajo page with a QR code to scan with a phone. Use it for a link that should send people to the right app store; for an ordinary link use shorten_url.

androidUrl.description: Where Android devices go: the app's Google Play page (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=...) or a Google Play test link (https://play.google.com/apps/internaltest/... or /apps/testing/...).

appName.description: The app's name for the page. Optional: looked up from the App Store when omitted.

customCode.description: Optional custom code (3-50 letters, digits, or hyphens) for a gajo.io/c/{code} link.

iosUrl.description: Where iPhones and iPads go: the app's App Store page (https://apps.apple.com/.../id...) or, for a beta, its TestFlight link (https://testflight.apple.com/join/...).

otherwise.description: The page every other device (such as a desktop) sees, always with a QR code of the link to scan with a phone: mobile_only says the link must be opened in a mobile browser; store_links lists both store URLs; store_badges shows the official App Store and Google Play badges under "Click below to download {appName}" and is only for apps published in both stores (use store_links or mobile_only for TestFlight and Google Play test links).

name: create_app_link

appLink.description: App links only: where iOS and Android go, and the page other devices see.

expiresDate.description: ISO-8601 instant; null when the link never expires.

title: Create an app store link
